lyrics.english: Here I am, writing the opening line again
I've never acted cute
But now I'm doing it for you
I really 4& you

lyrics.original: Ooh ooh my baby, 네가 기댈 어깬 여기에
lyrics.romanization: ooh ooh my baby, nega gidael eokkaen yeogie
lyrics.english: Ooh ooh my baby, Here's a shoulder you can lean on

lyrics.original: “Love you”, that's the only thing I can say, 오늘도 난

lyrics.english: “Love you”, that's the only thing I can say, Even tonight
Missing you more under the moonlight

lyrics.english: I love you, I love you, Let's stay together for just 400 years

have changed since I met you

lyrics.english: How could this be, I don't even wear my jeans inside out anymore, babe
Do you see how I feel?

lyrics.original: 한참은 더 부족한 나를, 이 바보를 따뜻하게 안아줘서
